messages:
carla: quick check — opened a TF change that adds a checksum annotation to our per-model ConfigMap so pods pick up flag updates without a full rollout. concerns? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8423

ben_t: link works, saw the PR. what's the exact reloader we expect to run? we currently only have a tiny in-app watcher for some flags — not sure it handles nested json keys.

carla: good Q. plan is to rely on stakater/reloader sidecar on the model runtime pod. the TF module will add the annotation: `checksum/configmap-model-flags: "${filemd5(var.model_flags_yaml)}"` so K8s picks up changes.

alice.s: fwiw the runtime will reload env vars from mounted files only if the process supports SIGHUP. our model-server doesn't. sidecar approach is fine but we either need a lifecycle hook to restart the main container or use the sidecar to write files and send a kill -SIGHUP.

carla: right — I added a small restart hook via `postStart` to watch for a sentinel. TF also adds `kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt` annotation patch by the reloader. snippet in PR: ```yaml
annotations:
  checksum/configmap-model-flags: "${var.flags_checksum}"
  reloader.stakater.com/match: "true"
```

dan: can you paste the terraform snippet? want to confirm we don't accidentally touch managed fields on managed deployments.

carla: sure — from the module: ```hcl
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "model_flags" {
  metadata {
    name = "model-flags-${var.model}"
    annotations = {
      "checksum/configmap-model-flags" = filebase64sha256(var.model_flags_file)
    }
  }
  data = { config.yaml = file(var.model_flags_file) }
}
```

emily: will external-secrets interfere? some customers use ES to inject secrets into the same pod — we need to ensure ordering so flags are mounted before reloader calculates checksum.

alice.s: ordering is important. Suggest we keep flags as ConfigMap (not ES) and only reference secrets via ExternalSecret/Secret. TF can compute checksum from the file at deploy time; but if ES later updates secret, that won't be reflected. for now doc the constraint.

ben_t: ^^^ agree — and add a lint rule to prevent mixing ES-produced secrets into the configmap file. otherwise we'll get silent mismatches.

carla: added a checklist in the PR description and flagged `ops-policy` for review. also added a unit test in the infra pipeline that verifies annotation is present when `enable_flag_live_reload = true`.

infra-bot: deploy-preview: infra-plan-ok for branch carla/configmap-reload — no drift detected. (checksums matched)

dan: PTAL @alice.s @ben_t — if you two are happy I can approve and merge later today. will run a staging rollout with canary=10% first.

alice.s: looked through, small nit about annotation key name (we prefer `checksum/configmap.redwood.com/`). can you update? otherwise LGTM.

ben_t: LGTM once key change is made. also add a short note in runtime/README about process restart behavior so future folks don't assume file updates auto-apply.

carla: will update now. thanks all. I'll wait for green tests then merge and coordinate the canary. :)

emily: re: oncall — if the canary causes increased OOMs we should rollback fast. adding a quick runbook: `kubectl rollout undo` + remove annotation to disable reloads. posting in #eng-oncall as FYI.

carla: perfect, noted. will ping here when merged.
